property_summary: For any successful non-reverting call to transfer, the return value must be true; the buggy version returns false, violating this invariant.

For any call to transfer with a non-empty _tos array and a caddress that, when called with abi.encodeWithSelector(id, from, _tos[i], v), does not revert for any i, the returned value must be true; the buggy version returns false, violating this invariant.
